7819.title: Reserved scrollbar gutter narrows diff context separators
7819.rootCauseOneLine: Chromium 152 reserves a 15px stable vertical gutter in the shared diff code container; inherited scrollbar color defeats the zero-width scrollbar rule, so 100cqi separators are narrower than the code area.

prReviews.verdict: SUPPORTED — static mechanism only; branch not executed
prReviews.topFinding: Shared gutter override matches the measured root cause; reviewed diff contains no regression test.

7819.proposedFix: Override the shared diff code container's gutter reservation through its shadow-root CSS options, preserving horizontal overflow and inherited scrollbar color.
7819.caveats: The same agent repeated the actual shared-component reproduction in a second clean checkout. Packaged Electron and other engines were not run. Existing PR #7821 closes this issue, so no duplicate fix PR was opened. Reproduction source and output are embedded in the HTML under the reports repository's publication policy.
